Usage: memoriahub scan [options] [command] [folder...]

Dry-run scan: preview and persist the file set a sync would process

Arguments:
  folder                 Paths to folders to scan (omit to use --all)

Options:
  --all                  Scan all registered enabled folders (default: false)
  --json                 Emit the report as JSON instead of a dashboard
                         (default: false)
  --no-report            Skip rendering the report after scanning
  -r, --recursive        Descend into sub-directories (when auto-registering a
                         folder) (default: false)
  --concurrency <n>      Number of concurrent metadata workers
  -h, --help             display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]         List recent scans
  report [options] [id]  Re-render a stored scan report (default: latest)
  export [options] <id>  Export a scan report to Excel (.xlsx) or CSV
